attorneys: Shelley v. Kraemer and McGhee v. Sipes, 334 U.S. 1. Mr. Justice Reed, Mr. Justice Jackson, and Mr. Justice Rutledge took no part in the consideration or decision of this case. Leon A. Ransom and Austin L. Fickling for petitioners.

opinions.text:
